newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wella broadens perfume deal with Gucci.
newsitem.headline: Wella broadens perfume deal with Gucci.

text.p: German cosmetics group Wella AG and Italian luxury goods company Gucci N.V. have agreed to expand their cooperation on Gucci perfume promotion, Wella said on Wednesday.
Under the terms of the new long-term agreement, Wella said it would take charge of international marketing, production and distribution.
Gucci will retain control of all creative and image aspects including product design, advertising and public relations activities, Wella said.
Wella acquired the licence for Gucci perfumes with its purchase of the French Muelhens group. It launched the Gucci perfume Envy in March with great fanfare.
